name: tests-75pct-cliproxyapi-resumable-protocol-streams
instr:
Add bounded stream-resume journal storage, disabled by default. Preserve existing behaviour.

Append immutable payload copies in per-session sequence order; separate sessions have independent positions. Attach and Snapshot replay only later records; Attach returns the latest cursor. Caller and snapshot buffer mutations must not change stored bytes. Sequential reconnects retain records appended after Detach; concurrent attachments return matching records and cursor positions.

Sessions share the same initial sequence and advance by one per Append; zero requests replay from the session start, subject to retention.

Enforce MaxBytesPerSession by removing complete oldest records; reject cursors older than the retained boundary. Enforce MaxSessions by evicting the least-recently-accessed detached session, with Snapshot refreshing recency. Unknown, future, endpoint-mismatched and evicted cursors return errors without replay; invalid attachments leave valid records available. Disabled Append returns an error, empty SessionID and zero Sequence; disabled Attach returns an error without records.

Invalid Attach returns empty Records and nil Terminal.

ParseStreamCursor rejects empty, unstructured and corrupt encoded text with *ResumeError containing nonempty string Code and nonzero StatusCode, and empty SessionID/zero Sequence.
